title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: hyperlinks in Edge warn and block notifications (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and the documented notification options, policy controls and licensing statements. It correctly distinguishes Windows notification documentation from the roadmap's Edge-specific change and reports the conflicting licensing sources. No blocking factual errors were found.

claims.claim: This is a Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention change.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Add support of hyperlinks in warn & block toast messages for Edge browser

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Edge warn and block notifications can contain a hyperlink when the Endpoint DLP rule is triggered.
claims.quote: Add support of hyperlinks in warn & block toast messages for Edge browser

claims.claim: The triggered notification has a customised title.
claims.quote: When this rule is triggered, the end user will see a toast with a customized title and message with a hyperlink.

claims.claim: The triggered notification has a customised message.
claims.quote: When this rule is triggered, the end user will see a toast with a customized title and message with a hyperlink.

claims.claim: The roadmap gives an internal policy SharePoint site as an example hyperlink destination.
claims.quote: This feature is useful when organizations need to direct users to a specific resource or a repository for more specific instruction (e.g. internal policy SharePoint site).

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Users and Prerequisites
claims.claim: Endpoint DLP detects sensitive-item activity and enforces protection on onboarded devices.
claims.quote: Once a device is onboarded, DLP detects when sensitive items are used and shared. This gives you the visibility and control you need to ensure that they're used and protected properly

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the hyperlink feature's arrival default or what happens to existing notifications.
claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP notification hyperlink default existing notifications automatically; "Endpoint DLP" "hyperlink" "default". Read roadmap, DLP policy reference, Endpoint DLP getting started and Edge DLP documentation; no arrival default stated.

claims.claim: The documented custom notification options are offered when Devices only is selected.
claims.quote: If you selected Devices only, you get all the same options that are available for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams Chat and Channel, and Instances, plus the option to customize the notification title, content, and add a hyperlink

claims.claim: The DLP policy reference documents custom notification titles.
claims.quote: plus the option to customize the notification title, content, and add a hyperlink

claims.claim: The DLP policy reference documents custom notification content.
claims.quote: plus the option to customize the notification title, content, and add a hyperlink

claims.claim: The documented hyperlink appears as a Get Support button on Windows 10/11 devices.
claims.quote: add a hyperlink in the form of a Get Support button that appears on the Windows 10/11 device.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The hyperlink must be a resolvable URL.
claims.quote: The hyperlink must be a resolvable URL, and it's abstracted behind a selectable control.

claims.claim: The hyperlink is abstracted behind a selectable control.
claims.quote: The hyperlink must be a resolvable URL, and it's abstracted behind a selectable control.

claims.claim: Block with override permits users to proceed using the Ok button on the Microsoft Edge notification.
claims.quote: Block with override: This option acts as a standard block but permits users to bypass it. By clicking the 'Allow' button on the toast notification or the 'Ok' button on the Microsoft Edge notification, users can proceed.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet specifically describe the hyperlink's rendering in Edge notifications.
claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP notification hyperlink Get Support Devices only policy tips Set-DlpComplianceRule; Endpoint DLP Edge notification hyperlink default existing notifications automatically Chrome Firefox pricing meter PowerShell hyperlink. Read policy reference and both cited Edge pages.

claims.claim: Endpoint DLP rule actions decide whether relevant Edge activity is audited, warned or blocked.
claims.quote: You can tell DLP to Allow, Audit only, Block with override, or Block (the actions) these user activities for onboarded Windows devices.

claims.claim: Custom policy tips come from the most restrictive rule, which need not be the rule performing the restriction.
claims.quote: Custom Policy Tips show for the most restrictive rule, not necessarily the rule that's performing the restriction.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The cited Edge documentation requires Microsoft 365 E5, Microsoft 365 E5 Compliance or Microsoft 365 Business Premium for Endpoint DLP.
claims.quote: Microsoft Endpoint data loss prevention requires a Microsoft 365 E5, a Microsoft 365 E5 Compliance, or a Microsoft 365 Business Premium subscription.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Endpoint DLP, including its rule notification options, is included in Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5 and the other suites listed in the Purview service description.
claims.quote:

| Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) | Included |

claims.claim: The service description's Endpoint DLP table does not list Business Premium.
claims.quote:

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no separate hyperlink-specific licence.
claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP notification hyperlinks separate licence price meter. Read Edge security licensing, Endpoint DLP prerequisites, Purview service description Endpoint DLP table and policy reference; results document product licensing, not a separate hyperlink entitlement or billing mechanism.

claims.claim: The deployment guide lists Compliance administrator, Compliance data administrator, Information Protection, Information Protection Admin or Security administrator for creating and deploying policies.
claims.quote:
The account you use to create and deploy policies must be a member of one of these role groups:
- Compliance administrator
- Compliance data administrator
- Information Protection
- Information Protection Admin
- Security administrator

claims.claim: The printed Purview path through Policies, Edit policy, Customize advanced DLP rules and rule Actions reaches Service domain and browser activities > Block with override.
claims.quote: Go to the Customize advanced DLP rules page and edit the Low volume of content detected scenarios U.S. PII Data Enhanced. Scroll down to the Actions > Audit or restrict activities on Windows device section and set both options under the Service domain and browser activities to Block with override.

claims.claim: Set-DlpComplianceRule -Identity <rule> -EndpointDlpRestrictions @(@{"Setting"="<Setting>"; "Value"="Warn"}) modifies an Endpoint DLP rule's restriction.
claims.quote: The EndpointDlpRestrictions parameter specifies the restricted endpoints for Endpoint DLP. This parameter uses the following syntax: @(@{"Setting"="<Setting>"; "Value"="<Value>}",@{"Setting"="<Setting>"; "Value"="<Value>"},...).

claims.claim: EndpointDlpRestrictions requires Compliance Administrator or Compliance Data Administrator in Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: This parameter requires membership in the Compliance Administrator or Compliance Data Administrator roles in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: Block and Warn values require NotifyUser as well.
claims.quote: The available values for <Value> are: Audit, Block, Ignore, or Warn. When you use the values Block or Warn in this parameter, also need to use the NotifyUser parameter.

claims.claim: Purview > Data loss prevention > Policies > policy > Edit policy > Customize advanced DLP rules > rule reaches the rule containing the documented custom notification options; the cited reference supplies no further UI step labels.
claims.quote: If you selected Devices only, you get all the same options that are available for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams Chat and Channel, and Instances, plus the option to customize the notification title, content, and add a hyperlink

claims.claim: No documented automation operation or Set-DlpComplianceRule parameter specifically configures the Endpoint DLP notification hyperlink.
claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP notification hyperlink PowerShell NotifyPolicyTipUrl Get Support. Read Set-DlpComplianceRule syntax and notification parameter descriptions; searched its text for hyperlink and NotifyPolicyTip names. NotifyPolicyTipUrl is documented for Exchange, not Endpoint DLP hyperlinks.

claims.claim: Set-DlpComplianceRule documents NotifyPolicyTipUrl for Exchange popup dialogs.
claims.quote: The NotifyPolicyTipUrl parameter specifies the URL in the popup dialog for Exchange workloads.

claims.claim: Custom policy tips can be localised using Set-DlpComplianceRule -NotifyPolicyTipCustomTextTranslations.
claims.quote: You can localize your custom policy tips by using the Set-DlpComplianceRule -NotifyPolicyTipCustomTextTranslations cmdlet.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor Learn specifically confirms that the Edge notification hyperlink also applies to Chrome and Firefox with the Purview extension.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "hyperlink" "Chrome" "Firefox". Read roadmap, policy reference and search excerpts for Chrome notifications, Firefox extension and browser restrictions; they document browser protection and notifications, not this Edge hyperlink's applicability to other browsers.

claims.claim: The custom notification hyperlink is an option configured within a DLP rule.
claims.quote: Rules: If you selected Devices only, you get all the same options that are available for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams Chat and Channel, and Instances, plus the option to customize the notification title, content, and add a hyperlink

claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no separate price for notification hyperlinks.
claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP notification hyperlinks separate licence price meter. Read Purview service description Endpoint DLP licensing table, Edge security subscription requirement and policy reference; no hyperlink-specific price stated.

claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no separate meter for notification hyperlinks.
